svg.aria-label: Cooling tower: a server block with a finned heat sink that glows red when it works. Warm water (red beads) runs along a channel to a cooling tower; its fan pulls air through louvers, part of the water evaporates (yellow puffs rise from the stack) and the cooled water (blue beads) runs back. A rail of five lamps counts drops of water; a dial reads the electricity the cooling takes.
